name: chunk_needles
description: Scan a local file, or one inode streamed from an image through icat, for ASCII and UTF-16LE needles; return per needle the counts and locators (id, offset in the scanned stream, encoding, context length) and a source that names the image, volume offset, inode and sector size. Every occurrence is found, overlapping ones included, whatever chunk is. Context bytes are NOT returned (they are where secrets sit): write_values: true, in a job run with secret_output: true, writes them to a 0600 file under $OUT. Needles are recorded in the trace: never put a secret in one. earlier_answers says how many other files answer the same question.

needles.description: Pipe-separated strings to search (ASCII/UTF-8 and UTF-16LE); at most 1000, each at most 4096 bytes; never a secret

inode.description: If set (and no path), icat this address from the image: a number, or number-type-id for an NTFS stream (168-128-4)

image.description: Image path. Defaults to the single disk image under inputs/: one with a disk image's extension, or one the catalogue read as a disk (catalog/<input>/partitions.txt).

offset.description: Volume offset in sectors for icat -o. Defaults to the one filesystem the catalogue lists for the image (catalog/<input>/p<start>/); several mean pass it; none is 0.

sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes for icat -b (a multiple of 512), when the image's is not 512

context.description: Bytes of context each side counted in context_length, and written with write_values (0 to 65536, default 60; 0 is 0)

max_hits.description: Locators returned inline per needle (default 20, at most 1000000); every one is in all_results when there are more

chunk.description: Read chunk size, 16 bytes to 256 MiB (default 8 MiB); results do not depend on it

write_values.description: Write each occurrence's context to a 0600 file under $OUT. Refused outside a job; run the job with secret_output: true. Default false.
